title: Stone profiniteness, reticulation spectra, and profinite-completion obstructions for residuated lattices
summary: We develop a profinite theory for bounded commutative integral residuated lattices around three related questions. First, we prove a Stone--profinite theorem: a topological residuated lattice is profinite exactly when its underlying space is Stone. The proof refines clopen congruences of the semiring reduct into clopen congruences in the full residuated-lattice signature via the 1-class filter.
